reasons.correctness: Adds a `@Version Long version` field and a BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 column. Build is green and acceptance tests pass 2/2. The client never sends a version (DtoIn is unchanged), so stale web/mobile reads are only caught within the load-save window.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset sits at 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-version-to-user-preferences.sql with header, changeset line and rollback. It is included last in changelog.xml under a Month comment. `@Version` field as prescribed. No new *UnitTest class; tests were appended to the existing UserPreferencesServiceUnitTest.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one entity field, one changeset, one include. It reuses the existing BusinessExceptionHandler optimistic-lock handling instead of adding a new mechanism. Nothing a maintainer would restructure.
reasons.test_quality: shouldExposeVersionField only tests a Lombok getter/setter. shouldRejectStaleSaveOnConcurrentUpdate stubs the mock to throw and then calls the mock directly, a tautology that never exercises UserPreferencesService. No new test class.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query located the userpreferences entity files. After that, navigation relied on find, grep for @Version and reading changelog directories. The example changeset and the exception handler were found by grep, not the graph.
